evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — a straightforward unload-only job (trailer already loaded) goes straight into logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — no concern was raised; the only unusual request (unloading motorcycles) was declined clearly and without friction.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: The 2.5-hour minimum was explained clearly, but the entire differentiator block (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) was skipped, and the estimate skipped the typical-range framing to jump straight to a personalized number.

top_strength: Clear, quick handling of an unusual unload-only request, including a firm and polite no on the out-of-scope motorcycle-unloading ask.
coaching_note: The customer declined immediately after hearing the price ('I think we might have pass') — with the full differentiator pitch skipped, there was nothing beyond price to anchor the value conversation to before she walked.
